goal_restatement: Add a customer-data export feature with a documented size ceiling and reviewed retention posture.
non_goals: Import. This plan covers export only.
Scheduled or recurring exports; this is on-demand only.
open_questions: Does the size ceiling apply per-request or per-account per-day?
Which regimes are in scope for s4 — is any non-EU transfer expected?
risks: A buffered implementation could exceed the memory ceiling at the maximum permitted size, which is why s2 depends on s1 rather than running beside it.
The legal review can complete while implementation proceeds, but a finding could invalidate the specified surface.

acceptance_criteria: Every supported format names its size ceiling
A partial export reports which records were skipped and why
steps.description: Specify the export surface: formats, size ceilings, and the failure modes a partial export must report.

acceptance_criteria: The decision states the memory ceiling it assumes
A rejected alternative is recorded with its reason
steps.description: Decide streaming versus buffered generation against the size ceiling from s1.

acceptance_criteria: Flag off is byte-identical to today
A partial export surfaces rather than silently truncating
steps.description: Implement the exporter behind a feature flag, defaulting off.

acceptance_criteria: Any unresolved transfer question is surfaced, not assumed
steps.description: Review the export against retention and cross-border transfer obligations.

summary: Four steps: specify the surface, decide the generation strategy against it, implement behind a default-off flag, and review the retention and transfer posture in parallel with implementation.
